message.name: DAILY_TASKS_INFO
message.value: You are looking at the menu of daily tasks. For completing them you can get valuable rewards: game currency, experience, resources, weapons and even temporary equipment!{br}Each day you will have access to 5 tasks randomly selected based on your level. Once you receive the tasks, you will have 24 hours to complete them. Rewards for completed tasks are automatically awarded at the end of the day, if they have not already been received earlier.{br}Partially completed tasks are not carried over to the next day – they will be changed to other tasks when the new game day starts. Try not to skip tasks, because completing each of them not only rewards you, but also brings you closer to opening chests with weekly rewards.

message.name: DAILY_TASKS_REPLACE_QTIP
message.value: If the task does not suit you, you can replace it. Three task replacements are available every day: the first one is free, the rest – for game currency. The replaced task will not appear until the end of the week, but a similar one may appear.
